svg.aria-label: AgentSetu architecture: the buyer agent can browse and create orders freely, but every payment call crosses into a separate mandate engine that checks the mandate, the attempt budget, every line item's category and the remaining cap before any money moves, with every decision written to a signed audit ledger.
svg.title: AgentSetu — how a payment actually happens
svg.desc: The LLM decides what to buy. Deterministic code in a separate process decides whether money moves.
